caption: Distribution of Quantifiers and Operations in Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, Disjunctive Reasoning, and Conjunctive Reasoning.
model_annotation: The presented pie charts illustrate the distribution of various quantifiers and operations across three categories: Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, and Disjunctive & Conjunctive Reasoning. The first chart, Categorical, consists of four slices: Limiter (27.91%, pink), Universal Quantifiers (29.07%, light blue), Negation (27.91%, light orange), and Existential Quantifiers (15.12%, light green). The second chart, Approximate Number Generation, displays three slices: Comparative Relationships (36.26%, blue), Absolute Absence (18.71%, light purple), and Approximate Quantities (45.03%, pale yellow). Finally, the third chart, Disjunctive & Conjunctive, includes two slices: Conjunctive (50.49%, pink) and Disjunctive (49.51%, light blue). Each chart features percentage labels within the slices, providing clear quantitative information. The slices in each pie chart do not appear to be visually emphasized or ordered in a particular arrangement based on size.
